name: Case law: United States, the Supreme Court of the United States
label: United States case law (the Supreme Court of the United States)
coverage: 386132 published decisions, one file each, dated the day decided: 337770 with their opinion text and 48362 with CAP head matter only (CAP holds no opinion text for them); 2905 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: each decision is added by one Kind: court commit; a Kind: correction commit (Corrects: the commit it corrects, Corrected: the day) later fixes a file's text or details, dated with the same In-force day, and is credited only with the lines it changed. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)

overlay.reader: tools/usc_cite.py: a page stamp ("USCA4") is no citation, "(a)(4)" a subsection, a range ("§§ 101-1330", "§§ 1 through 16") links neither end (its ends are no more cited than the sections between them); a citation under an older numbering (before the title was recodified, before the section was added, an earlier edition, "former") is not linked; one row per decision (decision-relations.tsv duplicates left out)

appended.reporters: U.S., S. Ct., L. Ed. 2d, B.R., Ct. Cl., Fed. Cl., Cl. Ct., Vet. App., Alaska Fed., Alaska, Ohio Law Abs., F. and 13 more

relations.same-decision-as: the file is the same decision as the target (same day, docket or name, and text); both are kept
relations.moved-to: the decision was routed here by mistake and is now at the target (<repo>/<path>); this file was removed

decision_dates.note: decisions whose CAP date gives only the month or the year (precision month or year): committed on the first day of it, In-force likewise
